svg.title: Sales Tax Compliance Cycle
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-sales-tax-compliance-cycle; chapter number: 6; chart type: funnel; title: Sales Tax Compliance Cycle; subtitle: Nexus, register, calculate, sort marketplace sales, then file and remit; caption: Since the 2018 Wayfair ruling, most states key economic nexus to $100,000 in sales or 200 transactions, and Avalara and LedgerGurus both insist on registering before collecting.; assumptions note: Funnel widths are ordinal stage positions (5 down to 1), not measured volumes. Dollar and count figures in each display are the practitioner numbers; California, New York and Texas set higher thresholds.; note: Sources: Cherry Bekaert [rUvJ4UwGqiA @ 00:01:00; 00:00:24], Avalara [EtT3YoVfP0c @ 00:19:36; 00:38:55; QiT660QtcXA @ 00:01:18], Arthur Glinkin [1Cr_iHc8p4s @ 00:07:44], LedgerGurus [-DhtTN5_Rh4 @ 00:12:28; 00:13:07].; stages: label: Nexus test; value: 5; display: $100,000 in sales or 200 transactions; conversion: Map every employee, rep, office and Amazon or 3PL inventory location; detail: Each of those creates physical nexus on its own (Cherry Bekaert).; label: Register before collecting; value: 4; display: Permit issued first; conversion: No collection enabled until the permit is in hand; detail: Collecting unregistered creates personal officer liability (Avalara).; label: Calculate the rate; value: 3; display: 13,000 permutations changing monthly; conversion: Engine handles rate, rule and boundary changes; detail: ZIP 30024 spans three counties (Avalara webinar presenters).; label: Sort marketplace and direct sales; value: 2; display: Amazon, Walmart and Etsy collect; conversion: Shopify is not a facilitator, so that tax stays with the seller; detail: Marketplace-collected sales are already handled (Avalara).; label: File and remit; value: 1; display: About $30-35 per TaxJar filing; $40-50 per Avalara return; conversion: Approve returns before the platform cutoff; detail: Avalara auto-files after the 11th at 5 PM ET; TaxJar's deadline is the 5th (LedgerGurus).

rect.title: label: Nexus test; value: 5; display: $100,000 in sales or 200 transactions; conversion: Map every employee, rep, office and Amazon or 3PL inventory location; detail: Each of those creates physical nexus on its own (Cherry Bekaert).

label: Register before collecting; value: 4; display: Permit issued first; conversion: No collection enabled until the permit is in hand; detail: Collecting unregistered creates personal officer liability (Avalara).

label: Calculate the rate; value: 3; display: 13,000 permutations changing monthly; conversion: Engine handles rate, rule and boundary changes; detail: ZIP 30024 spans three counties (Avalara webinar presenters).

label: Sort marketplace and direct sales; value: 2; display: Amazon, Walmart and Etsy collect; conversion: Shopify is not a facilitator, so that tax stays with the seller; detail: Marketplace-collected sales are already handled (Avalara).

label: File and remit; value: 1; display: About $30-35 per TaxJar filing; $40-50 per Avalara return; conversion: Approve returns before the platform cutoff; detail: Avalara auto-files after the 11th at 5 PM ET; TaxJar's deadline is the 5th (LedgerGurus).

text.title: Assumptions: Funnel widths are ordinal stage positions (5 down to 1), not measured volumes. Dollar and count figures in each display are the practitioner numbers; California, New York and Texas set higher thresholds.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Funnel widths are ordinal stage positions (5 down to 1), not measured volumes. Dollar and count figures in each display
are the practitioner numbers; California, New York and Texas set higher thresholds.

text.title: Stage widths/positions share a zero baseline; negative counts are unavailable.
